newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Pajaritos crude port opens as fog clears.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Pajaritos crude port opens as fog clears.

text.p: Mexico crude port Pajaritos in Veracruz state reopened at 1000 local/1800 GMT Wednesday after being shut more than three hours earlier amid dense fog, port officials said.
The port ships an average 400,000 barrels per day of crude exports, according to state-owned oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos figures.
Frontera port in Tabasco state remained shut as wind speeds were clocked at 40 to 50 km per hour.

The Communications and Transport Ministry said in its afternoon meteorological bulletin that wind speeds had fallen from the morning, although winds were still up to 38 km/22 miles in the Gulf of Tehuantepec and along the coast of Tamaulipas.
